case.summary: A total of 2 transaction(s) amounting to $165.93 on card C08623-K2 have been assessed as fraud with a probability of 0.99, matching card-present usage in a billing region where the cardholder has no prior history. The trigger was a customer report. Tool calls: 9 were made, and closed cases consulted: CC-4957, CC-3682, CC-2935. Rationale: Because the customer denied the transaction and the evidence confirms fraud, Fraud policy R2 requires the card to be blocked and a case created (POL‑R2). The out‑of‑region use pattern is documented in fraud pattern 4, which references policy R2, thereby justifying the same recommended actions (PAT‑4).
